items.title: Did Liverpool 'get lucky' with red card decision?
items.summary: Match of the Day pundits Danny Murphy and Ashley Young believe that Liverpool were perhaps "lucky" when Manchester United's Leny Yoro was sent off in the 8th-minute at Anfield.

items.title: How 'outstanding' Tzolakis kept Brighton at bay
items.summary: Match of the Day pundit Danny Murphy looks at how Hull goalkeeper Konstantinos Tzolakis was able to thwart high-flying Brighton in their 2-0 win over the Seagulls at the MKM Stadium.

items.title: 'We feel the pain': Pochettino on 4-0 defeat at Liverpool to start Manchester United era – video
items.summary: Liverpool thrashed 10-man Manchester United 4-0 at Anfield on Sunday to climb to fourth in the Premier League. But the defeat left United 19th, only one point above bottom-placed Crystal Palace. There was no new manager bounce for Mauricio Pochettino, who saw Leny Yoro sent off in the eighth minute
